1: You can create your loadout up to 3 primary guns with attachments, and throwables.
2: You can modify your gun attachments here, click on the guns and modify.
3: You can save your loadout here, make sure it's complete.
4: Press <key.bedgunwars.gun_menu> to open the Gun Selection Menu.
5: 10 seconds left, place your bed if not placed already!
6: 10 seconds left, get <winkills> eliminations to win.
7: Find hidden enemy beds, eliminate all.
8: You can get upgrades and replenish ammo by right clicking your bed. Earn $ from eliminations.
9: You can change your saved loadout during active match by pressing <key.bedgunwars.gun_menu>.
11: Scroll to change between killstreaks, click to activate.
12: Prevent yourself from being eliminated close to your bed, this can reveal your bed's position to your enemy.
13: Endgame phase, you will not respawn and the zone will shrink shortly.
